examples.q: Which US Olympic swimmer is nicknamed the ‘Baltimore Bullet’?
Which is the only nation to have won at least one medal in every Summer Olympic Games?
examples.reply: The United States is the only nation to have won at least one medal in every Summer Olympic Games.

examples.q: The medical condition aphakia affects which part of the body?
examples.reply: The medical condition aphakia affects the eye.

examples.q: Who composed the ‘Haffner Serenade’ (Serenade no.7) for the sister of his friend Sigmund Haffner, for her wedding festivities in 1776?
The Riel is the currency of which Southeast Asian country?
examples.reply: The Riel is the currency of Cambodia.

examples.q: what is the 21st letter of the Greek alphabet?
examples.reply: The 21st letter of the Greek alphabet is "Ypsilon" (uppercase Υ, lowercase υ).
